info.name: BookingEngineApi Account notes Service overbooking limits API

items.docs: Returns all service overbooking limits. Note this operation uses [Pagination](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/guidelines/pagination/) and supports [Portfolio Access Tokens](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/concepts/multi-property/).

Adds new service overbooking limits with the specified conditions. Past overbooking limits cannot be updated outside of `OperationalEditableHistoryInterval`. Care is needed to specify `FirstTimeUnitStartUtc` and `LastTimeUnitStartUtc` in the correct format - see [Datetimes](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/guidelines/serialization#datetimes). This operation supports [Portfolio Access Tokens](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/concepts/multi-property/).

Deletes service overbooking limits that exactly match the specified conditions. This operation is intended to be used alongside `serviceOverbookingLimits/set`. The specified conditions must be met exactly. The time interval, however, does not need to correspond to an existing service overbooking limit in the system, instead the API uses a splicing algorithm to work out how to divide up any existing service overbooking limit to meet the specified time interval.
